ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Churn", NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Low Risk")), /* allow the auto-created initial stage */ OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Type)), /* Full Churn / LOB Churn / Services Reduction */ ISBLANK(Amount), /* the negative churn value */ ISBLANK(Est_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(CloseDate) ) )
